title: Coupons
lead: A code cuts the item subtotal at checkout. Delivery, duties and the seller's share stay as they were.

deals.title: Deals
deals.lead: A lower price on one of Tracecart's own offers for a set time. It goes on the offer when it starts, with the old price struck through, and comes off when it ends. Carts see the change before paying.

giftCards.title: Gift cards
giftCards.lead: Money a customer spends at checkout, for part or all of an order. The code is shown once here, and emailed to the recipient when there is one.
giftCards.issued: Gift card for {amount} issued. Its code:
giftCards.issuedOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
giftCards.issuedEmailed: The recipient has been emailed it. It won't be shown here again.
